title: Part Sales set to Unassigned gives new part sales Unassigned
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} shows "Sales Representative - Service Labor" {Sales-rep-A}, "Sales Representative - Service Parts" {Sales-rep-B} and "Sales Representative - Part Sales" reading "Unassigned".
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Starting screen: the Part Sales page is open in a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Create a new part sale for {Customer-A}.
  2. Add a part and invoice the part sale without picking a representative.
  3. Open Reports > Sales By Representative for today with Show Unassigned on.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: its Sales Representative field reads "Unassigned".
  • Step 2: the part sale is invoiced.
  • Step 3: the whole part sale is credited to Unassigned, as one "Part Sales" row.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives), story SV-11269 (Story 5, Credit each side on the invoice and in Sales By Representative)

  • S4-R26: “A new part sale starts with the customer's Part Sales field when it is added: the person picked, or "Unassigned" when "Unassigned" was picked. Without a Part Sales field it starts with the Service Parts person, or the one representative when the customer is not split.”
  • S4-R14: “Picking a person, or "Unassigned", in the Part Sales field keeps that choice until someone changes the field or removes it. Changing Service Parts never changes it, even when both hold the same person.”
  • S4-R18: “A part sale invoiced with no representative is credited, for the whole sale, to the person new part sales get from the customer (S4-R26), or to nobody when the Part Sales field reads "Unassigned".”
  • S5-R9: “A part sale is one "Part Sales" row holding every dollar of the invoice.”
